Afterwards OpenMLS refuses every Commit that changes the record (UnsupportedProposalType; RFC 9420 §12.2, mls-extensions-11 §4.7): no new did_webvh user, no device with a newer log, no revocation, unless the same Commit removes that member. Options for Mark: (a) refuse such a member in a did_webvh group (Member::commit and the hub); (b) write AppDataUpdate into required_capabilities proposal_types when the record is set (decision mimid-1wgh.4.81.33 dropped required_capabilities); (c) have Member::commit remove such members automatically in a revocation Commit; (d) leave it and document it.
